scope: Deliver: repair The Desk signup, verify staging, commit and push main, fully deploy. No unrelated maintenance or identity migration.

items.title: Repair the public form response-header scope error
items.why: A production negative signup probe returned 503; the matching Worker log recorded JSON_HEADERS is not defined.
items.recipe: Share the response header constant across the two handlers and exercise the real Worker route's validation and forwarding branches.

evidence.interpretation: Production log captured through a bounded direct Worker tail. The invalid request could not send an email.
evidence.limitations: Initial read-only observability query had no retained logs for this Worker; direct tail supplied the exception.

L2.recipe: Fix scope and add route-level regression tests.

L3.recipe: Verify intended negative responses on staging and production.

executionLog.note: 78/78 route and existing Worker tests passed; staging Worker version 7d255cc2-1440-493c-b824-6b4912a351bf returns intended 403 instead of 503.

items.title: Restore the existing widget secret to the public-form Worker
items.why: Production binding inspection found no TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY. Staging after the code repair returns turnstile_not_configured.
items.recipe: Validate the source-owned widget and account, provision only its existing secret to staging, verify, then promote under the current release gate. Do not rotate or change widget domains.

premises.claim: Public forms require the Worker Turnstile secret

evidence.interpretation: Cloudflare settings read and widget read confirm the missing binding and the existing VaultSpark widget.
evidence.limitations: The shared gateway Turnstile capability may belong to a sibling; source widget identity must be validated.

L2.recipe: Use a bounded, dry-by-default provisioning tool with scope checks.

L3.recipe: Exercise a real browser challenge and verify the complete authorized signup.

executionLog.note: Provisioning tool validates account, source widget, allowed hostname and Worker origin; 8/8 unit tests pass. Staging existing secret attached and binding readback confirmed. Negative route returns intended missing-token 403. Real browser challenge timed out.

items.title: Pin the verifier to this website and make real sends explicit
items.why: The previous shared-URL resolver tested a different project. Its endpoint checks failed while the site's actual endpoint passed.
items.recipe: Pin the repository project and assert management visibility; default to no send; require a valid explicit mailbox and correlate provider evidence to a new current message.

premises.claim: The site-owned project is pinned in the Worker endpoint

evidence.interpretation: Corrected live no-send verification passes 6/6; unit checks prove target and send boundaries.
evidence.limitations: No-send verification does not prove successful delivery.

L2.recipe: Add authority check, explicit send option and current-message evidence tests.

L3.recipe: Verify one authorized real confirmation through the public form.

executionLog.note: 7/7 verifier tests passed; live no-send checks 6/6 passed. No email sent.

items.title: Never return an already-consumed challenge token on retry
items.why: The existing TODO reproduced the same single-use token being returned on the next call.
items.recipe: Cache only tokens that have not been delivered to a waiting caller and promote the existing TODO to a passing browser regression test.

executionLog.note: 6/6 challenge lifecycle tests pass, including a second distinct token on retry.

L2.recipe: Require a second distinct token in the browser regression.

L3.recipe: Verify the retry behavior on the deployed site.
